label: Ribbon Flatworm
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One independent square transparent Glaze artwork. PELLICLE SHOAL, fictional sea organisms sculpted entirely from WET BACTERIAL-CELLULOSE PELLICLES. Our own reference sea-dragon supplies only the physical material and soft lighting; create a different subject. Very thin cloudy translucent amber/tea/ivory bio-fibre membranes, densely visible fine cellulose fibrils, irregular torn fibrous edges, doubled opaque fold lips and a few water beads at seams. Diffuse light through cloudy fibre with loose folded laminae and genuine gaps, convincing macro craft photograph. No smooth solid core, glass, glossy resin, gelatin candy, plastic, ordinary animal skin, woven fabric, wood shavings, paper quilling, metal or thread. Entire subject inside central70% with generous true transparent margins; every projecting arm, fin or tail whole. No environment, exterior glow, external bubbles, floor, cast shadow, backing panel, frame, typography, UI or clock/battery/calendar symbols. One readable singular silhouette at85px, no sheet/collage. SUBJECT: one whole broad RIBBON FLATWORM gliding in an elegant low horizontal S with a wide undulating ruffled mantle and two small curled ear-like head folds at left. A single continuous amber/ivory fibrous cellulose ribbon, with thin translucent side flounces and thicker doubled pale fold lips, changing from a broad flat head region into a gently tapering folded tail at right. Side flounces wave in three or four large distinctive curls, not dozens of tentacles. A slightly raised longitudinal soft fold traces the back. No eyes drawn on top, no vertebrate face, shell, fins or legs. Show the entire continuous body and both head folds with comfortable transparent margin, no clipped ribbon ends.
processing: Entire original uniformly contained within900px on transparent1024square. Alpha preserved, no subject crop/recolour/artistic edits.
